content:
#4 large recursion of higher inductive types uses equivalences between types and transport, not paths between types and the action on paths, even in the version of dependent type theory with universes. Thus, removed the paragraphs in the Large recursion principles section about the so-called “large recursion principles” wrongly defined using paths between types and function application.
